labels.text:
To deliver secure AI generation and platform features, we use trusted sub-processors:
• OpenAI & DeepInfra: AI resume analysis and enhancement.
• RevenueCat: In-app purchase verification and subscription management.
• Firebase (Google): Push notification delivery.
• Sentry: Crash reporting and error diagnostics with PII scrubbing.
